nominees.name: Sarah Huckabee Sanders
team: Staff announced July 31, 2026: Heather Patterson (Director of Advance and Coalitions), Josh Stewart (Director of Legislative Affairs), Zach Jacobs (Policy Director).

positions.stance: Fourth income-tax cut (about $180 million) after cutting rates 20% over three years; lawmakers signaled a special session on tax cuts.
Top priority; credits LEARNS Act; school vouchers up to $309 million (+$122 million) plus up to $70 million surplus.
1,500 new prison beds, tougher sentencing, $53.4 million employee pay plan mostly for corrections and troopers.
No new Medicaid coverage mandates; no new multiyear spending obligations.

policyShifts.shift: Another income-tax cut after the fiscal session.
Voucher funding grows to about $309 million.
Continued prison expansion and a repeat-offender pilot.

impediments.title: Voucher cost growth
impediments.detail: Opponent argues spending diverts public money from public schools and tax cuts favor wealthier residents.

impediments.title: Prison siting
impediments.detail: Proposed 3,000-bed Franklin County prison not mentioned in her budget message.

insights: Second-term continuity: personnel changes come in the governor's office (new policy, legislative and coalitions directors) rather than agency heads, per sources opened.
The key calendar item is the special session on tax cuts after the fiscal session.
